$comment: Curated subset of mino.mobi's surfaces, pulled from https://mino.mobi/deploy-registry.json and sorted into 7 vibe categories for the mobiusmatch quiz. Re-pull with ../sync-mino.mjs — it re-fetches the registry and warns about any surface that isn't in its CATEGORY_MAP yet, but leaves the curated picks/blurbs alone (there's no automatic way to guess which of ~100 surfaces belongs in a 6-per-category quiz).
